title: iQube Electric 3.4kWh (Special Edition)
description: Engineered for riders seeking confident performance and refined dynamics, the TVS Motor Company iQube Electric 3.4kWh (Special Edition) is engineered for instant twist-and-go urban mobility with generous under-seat utility. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against a curb weight of 108 kg, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. Riders are greeted by an ergonomic Step-Through Upright posture paired with an accessible 765mm seat height that allows easy flat-footing for virtually all rider heights, backed by a 14L fuel tank for extended saddle stints.
